name: HAPPO-EN
accessSummary: Shirokanedai Station (Tokyo Metro Namboku Line / Toei Mita Line) Exit 2: 1 min walk
hours: Inquiries accepted Weekdays 10:00-19:00 / Sat, Sun & holidays 9:30-19:30

rooms.note: Honzen (formal individual-tray meal) 150 guests; low-table (zataku) seating 150 guests. A grand hall of 144 tatami mats. A separate page (Meetings) lists school 160 and theater 387.

rooms.name: WASHI
rooms.note: The Meetings page lists a maximum area of 333㎡, theater 280 and school 120 (2 per desk) / 180 (3 per desk), which differs from the figures in the banquet hall list (theater 400, school 220). Two 147-inch screens, projector, ceiling speakers and internet connection (LAN and wireless) available.

ops.waitingRooms: The whole 4F of the main building is waiting rooms, which can also be used for breakout sessions after a large meeting or for small meetings. The members-only CLUB FLOOR has its own waiting rooms.
ops.catering: For banquets and meetings, HAPPO-EN plans and provides the food as well. Meals for allergies, vegan, vegetarian and similar needs are available. Catering is for venues outside HAPPO-EN, and there is a plan for 50 guests or more at 13,200 yen per person (tax and service charge included).
ops.parking: There is a parking lot for up to 107 cars, and parking is free of charge. (Answer to an FAQ about family introduction meetings (kaogoshirae) and betrothal gift ceremonies (yuino))
ops.restaurants: The grounds have the Japanese restaurant (ryotei) Kochuan (also listed as a banquet room, up to 40 guests), ALL DAY DINING FUDO, Kappou BUTAI and the HAPPO-EN Patisserie.
